They're in hallway 328.|A [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droid]] to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Hallway 328''' was a hallway on the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] where [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were detained by [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shields]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. The trio, alongside [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], were subsequently captured by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|troops]], made up of two [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], multiple [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]], and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]].

==Behind the scenes==
The non-[[canon]] deleted scene "Grievous Slaughters a Jedi (Escape from the General)" was played in Hallway 328. In the scene, General Grievous and a battalion of his battle droids encounter Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker who witness the execution of [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] shortly thereafter.
